description.p: nailong is a lightweight Minecraft: Java Edition launcher written in Rust. Choose a Minecraft version and Fabric, NeoForge, Forge or vanilla, watch the install progress, and launch the game with an offline account. Incomplete downloads are detected and can be repaired.
It ships as a single native executable with no bundled runtime and keeps the launcher itself small.

Loader base versions are hidden from the main picker, with a management page for deleting versions and instances. Reinstalling an intact loader is now instant, and the 3 MB core data is fetched in parallel.
Forge and NeoForge installs now fetch only the core installer data (about 3 MB) instead of the full 7–9 MB package; mirrors without range support fall back safely.
Fabric, NeoForge, Forge and vanilla installs, with version pickers, progress and repair.
